     --shards M --shard i. The paid suite has the same in scripts/test-paid-shards.ts. Both share runShardChild. All
     four files the plan would duplicate have pinning tests today (test/test-free-shards.test.ts, 
     test/paid-shards.test.ts, test/strict-output.test.ts, test/run-shard-child.test.ts). The full free suite runs in
     about 90 to 100 seconds for roughly 8,700 tests.

     evaluate the Bun built-in first. TODOS.md has an open P2 item: swap the custom LPT packer for bun-native
     --timings/--shard once the repo unpins Bun 1.3.13. CI and this machine are now on Bun 1.4.0, so that unpin has
     already happened and the item is ready to execute.

     coverage, watch, and progress files outright. Bun's own docs confirm timings-based LPT shard balancing composes
     with --parallel (Bun test docs (https://bun.com/docs/test), Bun v1.3.13 release (https://bun.com/blog/bun-v1.3.13),
     Jarred Sumner on --timings (https://x.com/jarredsumner/status/2084447410567409776), Bun test deep dive
